label: Figure 29.1: The elements of the GII
alt: Tree diagram showing the Gender Inequality Index built bottom-up from female and male gender indices, each built from health, empowerment and labour market dimension indices and their underlying indicators.
caption: The Gender Inequality Index (GII) is built bottom-up. Indicators (maternal mortality ratio, adolescent birth rate, secondary education, parliamentary seats, labour force participation, split by sex where relevant) combine into five dimension indices, which combine into a female gender index and a male gender index, which finally combine into the overall GII.
